# NeoStation iOS 0.0.4

This release brings the skin catalog and fixes for PSP and Nintendo 3DS to NeoStation iOS.

## What's new

- **Skin catalog:** browse the **[Provenance Skin Catalog](https://github.com/Provenance-Emu/skins)** for NeoStation's embedded Libretro consoles, install compatible skins, and choose separate portrait and landscape layouts.
- **PSP:** fixed an issue that prevented games from launching.
- **Nintendo 3DS:** fixed a crash that occurred when closing a game.

Thank you to the emulator developers and the NeoStation community for your work, feedback, and patience!

## Using skins

Open **Settings → Folders → Embedded consoles**, choose a console, then **Skins**.
Use **Browse the Provenance catalog** or **Import from Files**, then select
**Use in portrait**, **Use in landscape** or **Use in both orientations**.

See the **[skin guide](https://github.com/TarbleFR/neostation-ios/blob/08145438cc907b22b7b860bf190d1b520040fef1/docs/SKINS.md)** for supported archive formats, default skins, game-specific choices and catalog sources.

Catalog credits go to the **Provenance community**, format-reference credits to **Riley Testut and DeltaCore contributors**, and artwork credits to each **skin creator**. Community skins are optional downloads and retain their creators' terms.

## Download

Download **`NeoStation-0.0.4.ipa`** below and sign it with your usual sideloading tool.

`NeoStation-0.0.4-SHA256SUMS.txt` contains the IPA checksum.

## Release information

- **Release:** 0.0.4
- **Internal build:** 435
- **Source commit:** `90a4e513e3a97f642bc45963bfb689f7c4677d46`
- **Build:** [GitHub Actions run 38072379293](https://github.com/TarbleFR/neostation-ios/actions/runs/38072379293)

This release distributes the existing Build 435 IPA. Its contents have not been rebuilt or modified; the download filename and GitHub release name use version 0.0.4. The app bundle retains its original marketing version, 0.0.2, and internal build number, 435.
